identity_resolution_order: Probabilistic match retained as unresolved candidate
prohibited_merges: Do not merge people on name alone.
Do not merge companies across jurisdictions without identifiers.
Do not merge datasets and publications merely because titles match.
Do not collapse historical organizations into current successors without a temporal edge.
Do not infer patient identity or sensitive attributes.

source_status_semantics.existing-active: Already represented by an existing managed provider or governed source family.
source_status_semantics.backbone-candidate: High-value registry, ontology, federated catalog, or discovery API prioritized for direct bounded activation.
source_status_semantics.catalog-only: Registered for discovery and graph mapping; no new direct runtime connector is asserted.
source_status_semantics.conditional-free: Free or metadata-free only under an account, key, eligibility rule, or limited-use license.
source_status_semantics.application-required: Requires institutional, research, data-use, or manual approval.
source_status_semantics.web-only: Official public web source with no stable verified programmatic contract.
source_status_semantics.deferred: Potentially useful but blocked by endpoint, security, duplication, or governance issues.
